notes:
Status: Stalled / effectively closed-lost for now. POC never reached execution.

Quick summary: customer evaluated Redwood for secure, low-latency inference for payments productization (fraud reranking + agent chat). High interest early — AE/Sales engineer traction in Nov/Dec. Security and infra were the gating factors. They required VPC or on-prem with KMS/HSM; also heavy audit/residency needs.

Timeline (bulleted):
- 2025-11-12: Intro call (AE: Sofia) — product fit for real-time fraud reranking. Customer: VP Eng + Head of Data.
- 2025-12-03: Demo (live) of hosted API; SE overview of batching and latency SLOs (Diego).
- 2025-12-15: Security kickoff (fireflies ff_2026-01-22 reference created during calls). Customer asked for detailed HSM/KMS flow and private deployment checklist.
- 2026-01-20: Proposal + pricing deck shared (drive:/decks/grayhaven_prod_eval_deck_v2.pdf). Asked for on-prem appliance cost comparison.
- 2026-01-27: Legal & security call — requested on-prem proof-of-concept and HSM integration details. We estimated ~6 weeks prep for on-prem test harness.
- 2026-02-03: Customer informs of company-wide hiring freeze and budget re-prioritization; champion (Sr. ML Eng, "Maya") promoted to a different org — cause: no internal champion to staff POC.
- 2026-02-10: Competitive intel: OpsAI offered on-prem appliance trial bundled with professional services at lower upfront cost.
- 2026-02-15: Final outreach from AE (exec intro offer) — no response.

Why POC didn't start:
- Never aligned on measurable success criteria — customer expected Redwood to define SLA targets and fraud-tx sampling metrics, but internal data owner pulled back.
- Resourcing: no engineering bandwidth on customer side to run POC (headcount freeze).
- Security: heavy legal/KMS/HSM questions; customer wanted on-prem appliance demo which Redwood could provide but timeline/ops cost mismatch.
- Commercial: OpsAI undercut price with included professional services — cheaper short-term option for them.

Customer quotes / notes from calls:
- "We cannot commit developer time for a POC while hiring is frozen." — VP Engineering (2026-02-03).
- "If we can't see an on-prem appliance in our lab, security won't sign off." — InfoSec lead (2026-01-27).

Current disposition / recommended follow-up:
- Status: Stalled / close-lost-light — mark as cold.
- Next outreach window: target re-engagement in 2026-07 after FY26 budget refresh.
- Assets to prepare before re-engagement: concise security pack with HSM/KMS flows, one-pager comparing Redwood on-prem/DEDICATED cost vs OpsAI appliance, sample success criteria template for fraud reranking POC (latency, throughput, precision@N).
- Low-effort touch: send security FAQ + short note from Diego summarizing HSM compatibility and time-to-POC estimate.
- Blockers to resolve before POC: reassign internal champion; budget allocation; formal security scoping call with infra + legal.
